content:
sara: saw a p95 jump on canary after the quantization matmul merge last night. Noticed ~2.3x increase for some long-context pods.
leo: can you paste the perf summary and the canary id?
sara: canary id c-879. p50 unchanged, p95 from 45ms -> 105ms on decode. Throughput stable. stack traces look like memory thrash around KV refill.
jamie: :eyes: kv underflow? we changed the prefetch heuristic in the same CL, right?
anita: yep, CL 5123 adjusted prefetch window for quantized paths. Might be interacting badly with async evict.
perf-bot: perf check: https://perf.internal/reports/c-879  (CI flagged p95 +2.3x)
sara: attaching hot trace snippet and small profile (top C++ frames):
```
decode_one_step()  +120ms
kv_cache_refill()  +85ms
MatMulQuantized::compute() +30ms (memcpy spikes)
kernel_selector::choose_kernel() +12ms
```
mike: interesting that MatMulQuantized only +30ms. If KV refill is +85ms that suggests cache miss storm. Could be microbatch ordering changed.
leo: can we repro locally? I'll spin a canary replica with trace-level logging and run the same workload.
jamie: also get GPU metrics: page faults, memcpy/stalls. Quantized code path uses different workspace allocation.
anita: quick experiment: reverting the prefetch window change in staging removed the p95 jump (ran 30m). Suggests prefetch heuristic is the trigger.
sara: can we bisect to the exact commit? CLs: 5110 (matmul quant), 5123 (prefetch), 5130 (scheduling tweak). Canary timeline matches 5123 deploy time.
leo: I'll bisect between 5110..5130 tomorrow. For now hold canary rollout and mark as rollout-blocker.
deploy-bot: Canary c-879 paused: p95 > threshold. Rollout blocked.
jamie: also flag CI perf job to fail forward if p95 regresses >1.5x until we have a fix.
anita: for mitigation we can reduce prefetch aggressiveness for quantized models (short-term) or force fallback kernel selection for long contexts.
mike: once leo has bisect traces, we can decide revert vs targeted patch. thx all.
leo: starting bisect in 15m. I'll post findings.
sara: thanks. tagging @oncall for visibility.
